title: Peter Knorre and Rudolf Schenk von Tautenburg to Duke Wilhelm III of Saxony, ciphered embassy reports on the Luxembourg succession, 1462-63 (SächsHStA Dresden, Wittenberger Archiv, Loc. 4356/01; lost 1945)

documents.shelfmark: Sächsisches Staatsarchiv, Hauptstaatsarchiv Dresden, 10005 Wittenberger Archiv, Loc. 4356/01, Bl. 380, 490, 494, 530, 531, 538, 540, 564, 565, 572, 574, 575
documents.route: Peter Knorre, Rudolf Schenk von Tautenburg (Brussels, Bruges) -> Wilhelm III, Duke of Saxony

plaintext.source: The finding aid says part of Bl. 540 was deciphered; the sheet is lost and only the archivist's one-line summary survives.

transcription.notes: The volume is marked 'Fehlt: Kriegsfolge' (lost 1945) on archiv.sachsen.de, checked 28 Oct 2026. Nothing transcribed. cleartext_in_document is taken from the finding aid ('größtenteils', 'teils chiffriert').

system.summary: unknown: the letters are lost and were never seen by the project.
system.notes: symbol_kind and key_order are placeholders: the schema has no 'unknown' value for them. Nothing about the system is known.

conditions.human_role: Pasted the catalogue task; no other input. Brice Dudout had reported the loss notes by email on 27 Oct 2026.

solution.what: Archivportal-D and archiv.sachsen.de records for Bl. 540, 538, 575, 530, the ciphered Befehl and the volume Loc. 4356/01: no images; all marked 'Fehlt: Kriegsfolge'. The volume is lost.

Web searches (Knorre + Wilhelm III + Luxemburg 1462 + chiffriert; Knorre provost of Wetzlar 1463; Würth-Paquet regests) and an Archivportal-D 'Knorre' search: no edition, decipherment or second copy found.

outcome.notes: Not attempted on the ciphertext: the originals are recorded as lost in 1945. Only a pre-war film or copy (SächsHStA, AGR/ADN, Weimar) would reopen it.
